why_it_breaks: The drawdown halt guard at line 276 only blocks a buy order if BOTH halt_high_risk is True AND the order has sleeve="high_risk". The observed trade was a buy of FALN at $2.10 that filled without rejection. If FALN's sleeve was not set to "high_risk" (e.g., it was "core" or another sleeve), the condition would evaluate to False and the order would pass through unblocked, even though drawdown was -30.0% which is below the -20% halt threshold. The agent overlooked the case where a buy order occurs during drawdown but the ticker's sleeve is not "high_risk", so the drawdown halt does not activate.
